text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Eh!?
Tsuru-chan, you also promised to run with the President?
You didn't get the date wrong, did—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, neither of you have the wrong date.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Friendly rivalry. If one wishes to master running,
polishing one another is the supreme path.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The more whetstones to sharpen against, the better.
Now then, let us run together... to shine with dazzling brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text:
In that case... I'll be the one to shine the brightest!
In that case... I will be the one who shines the brightest!
